title: Preparation and performance study of CTBN/nano-SiC composite toughened Xanthoceras sorbifolia oil-based adhesive
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24006-24020
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09970F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rao Duan, Jie Wang, Yihua Zhang, Zhenpeng Wang, Lei Jiao, Yan Long, Tao Hou, Gaole Zhao, Yinan Hao
Using Xanthoceras sorbifolia oil as a raw material, a high-performance adhesive was successfully prepared and applied in table tennis blade plywood, providing an ideal sustainable alternative to petroleum-based adhesives.
